paragraphs: The SL55 AMG sits at the heart of the current-generation R232 SL range, which marked a significant shift for the model - the SL moved to Mercedes-AMG exclusively with this generation. The SL55 uses the M177 - a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 that's a genuine AMG-designed engine, hand-assembled and shared with other AMG performance models. It replaced the naturally aspirated M156 and earlier M157 variants in the SL's line-up, bringing a torque-rich, responsive character that defines the modern AMG driving experience.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SL55 AMG on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the SL55 AMG from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
